top_choice_rationale: GLP-1 is the mature, independently confirmed chain from incretin physiology to medicine. P002 (Drucker, Holst, Knudsen) rewards both the physiology and the design of long-acting agonists, which is the step that turned a peptide with a half-life of minutes into a drug. It rests on better-documented attribution than the contested Mojsov-Habener priority. P001 is a defensible discovery-only alternative, and I rank it above no award.
